name: SC6-M1: Helm Chart & Inference Health Probes Interactive Lab
description: Interactive lab for configuring Kubernetes health probes for slow-loading AI inference models and sequencing Helm chart deployment steps on AKS.

course_metadata.module: Module 1: Package and Deploy with Helm
course_metadata.learning_objective: LO1: Apply Helm charts to deploy containerized inference services to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and validate roll-outs with health probes.
